newsitem.title: USA: Cell Robotics gets laser device okay.
newsitem.headline: Cell Robotics gets laser device okay.

text.p: Cell Robotics International Inc said Tuesday that it has received clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market its Lasette laser finger perforator for glucose testing.

The Lasette is a small, hand-held battery-operated laser device that produces a small hole in the finger with a single pulse of laser light and replaces the steel lancet for capillary blood collection.
This initial clearance is for glucose and hematocrit testing in adult patients by professional health care providers.
The company said it will apply for FDA clearances for juveniles in clinical settings and home-use for diabetics at a later date.
